description: From the Battlefield to the Ballot Box…Kerry Loudenslager, a lifelong South Dakotan, decorated Army Colonel, proven leader, and devoted husband, father, and grandfather has spent his life serving others. Now he's stepping up to serve House District 12 in South Dakota.
